name: Zylo
summary: Zylo finds software by reading financial systems such as ERP, accounts payable and expense records, then matches purchases to apps. It compares purchased licenses with usage data and keeps a renewal calendar ranked by savings potential. Plans are Core, Premium and Enterprise, all priced by quote.

facts.text: Zylo says its AI scans ERP, accounts payable and expense systems to find software purchases and match them to applications.
Zylo says it gets usage data through integrations with supported SaaS apps to flag inactive users and underused seats.
Zylo describes a centralized renewal calendar that can be ranked by spend and recommends starting renewal preparation about 120 days ahead. The page does not mention renewal alerts.
Zylo's trust center lists SOC 2 Type 2 and GDPR. It does not list ISO 27001.

plans.name: Zylo Core
plans.notes: For teams building a SaaS system of record. No price published.

plans.name: Zylo Premium
plans.notes: Adds task automation and workflow connections. No price published.

plans.name: Zylo Enterprise
plans.notes: For large global teams with multiple instances. No price published.
